strands.name: Strand A: Scientific Investigation Skills and Career Exploration

overalls.title: Scientific Investigation Skills
overalls.description: demonstrate scientific investigation skills (related to both inquiry and research) in the four areas of skills (initiating and planning, performing and recording, analysing and interpreting, and communicating)

specifics.description: I can ask scientific questions, make predictions, and plan safe investigations.
I can conduct experiments, collect accurate data, and organize it effectively.
I can analyse and interpret data, identify sources of error, and draw evidence-based conclusions.
I can communicate my findings using scientific language, appropriate formats, and precise measurements.

overalls.title: Career Exploration
overalls.description: identify and describe careers related to the fields of science under study, and describe the contributions of scientists, including Canadians, to those fields

specifics.description: I can identify science-related careers and describe the education and training required.
I can describe the contributions of Canadian scientists to the fields under study.

strands.name: Strand B: Matter, Chemical Trends, and Chemical Bonding

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse the properties of commonly used chemical substances and their effects on human health and the environment, and propose ways to lessen their impact

specifics.description: I can analyse the environmental and health impacts of chemical substances and propose ways to reduce harm.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate physical and chemical properties of elements and compounds, and use various methods to visually represent them

specifics.description: I can use periodic trends and Lewis structures to predict and represent chemical bonding.
I can name and write chemical formulae for compounds using IUPAC nomenclature.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of periodic trends in the periodic table and how elements combine to form chemical bonds

specifics.description: I can explain the relationship between atomic structure, isotopes, and periodic trends.
I can explain how elements form ionic and covalent bonds and compare the properties of the resulting compounds.

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse chemical reactions used in a variety of applications, and assess their impact on society and the environment

specifics.description: I can analyse the societal and environmental impacts of chemical reactions used in industrial applications.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate different types of chemical reactions

specifics.description: I can write balanced chemical equations and predict products for different types of reactions.
I can investigate chemical reactions through inquiry, including synthesis, decomposition, displacement, and neutralization.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the different types of chemical reactions

specifics.description: I can identify different types of chemical reactions and explain the differences between them.
I can explain the formation of acids and bases from metal and non-metal oxides.

strands.name: Strand D: Quantities in Chemical Reactions

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse processes in the home, the workplace, and the environmental sector that use chemical quantities and calculations, and assess the importance of quantitative accuracy in industrial chemical processes

specifics.description: I can analyse the use of chemical quantities and calculations in real-world applications and assess the importance of quantitative accuracy.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate quantitative relationships in chemical reactions, and solve related problems

specifics.description: I can perform stoichiometric calculations involving moles, mass, percentage composition, and empirical formulae.
I can solve problems involving percentage yield and limiting reagents, and conduct inquiries to determine reaction yields.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the mole concept and its significance to the quantitative analysis of chemical reactions

specifics.description: I can explain the mole concept and its relationship to Avogadro's number, molar mass, and quantitative analysis.
I can explain the quantitative relationships expressed in balanced chemical equations.

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse the origins and effects of water pollution, and a variety of economic, social, and environmental issues related to drinking water

specifics.description: I can analyse the origins and effects of water pollution and assess issues related to drinking water.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate qualitative and quantitative properties of solutions, and solve related problems

specifics.description: I can solve problems involving solution concentration and prepare solutions of given concentrations.
I can use stoichiometry, net ionic equations, and titration techniques to analyse solutions.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of qualitative and quantitative properties of solutions

specifics.description: I can explain the properties of water as a solvent and the factors affecting solubility.
I can explain the Arrhenius theory of acids and bases and the difference between strong and weak acids and bases.

strands.name: Strand F: Gases and Atmospheric Chemistry

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse the cumulative effects of human activities and technologies on air quality, and describe some Canadian initiatives to reduce air pollution, including ways to reduce their own carbon footprint

specifics.description: I can analyse the effects of human activities on air quality and describe Canadian initiatives to reduce air pollution.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate gas laws that explain the behaviour of gases, and solve related problems

specifics.description: I can investigate the relationships between pressure, volume, and temperature of gases using gas laws.
I can solve quantitative problems involving gas laws and stoichiometry for gaseous reactions.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of the laws that explain the behaviour of gases

specifics.description: I can use kinetic molecular theory and gas laws to explain the behaviour of gases.
I can describe the components of Earth's atmosphere and explain Avogadro's hypothesis.
